_doc: Curated raw-unreal.* → tether-equivalent map. Each entry causes preflight to emit a warning (NOT a rejection) when the raw pattern appears, with the tether-equivalent code shown inline. Driven by audit-log evidence: only patterns observed in real agent runs go in here. Add more as new fallbacks surface in exec.log.

redirects.tether_replacement:
from tether import Asset
Asset.search_assets(query=..., scope=unreal.TetherAssetSearchScope.ALL_ASSETS, class_filter=..., case_sensitive=False, whole_word=False, max_results=..., min_characters=1, custom_package_path='')
# OR for path-restricted listing:
Asset.list_assets_under_path(folder_path=..., include_subfolders=True)
redirects.reason: Raw asset registry walks bypass preflight, audit logging, and have no token-cost guard — tether wrappers do all three. ALL_ASSETS scope catches plugin assets PROJECT scope misses.
Direct tether equivalent. Returns paths instead of AssetData objects, so no .asset_class_path attribute confusion.

redirects.tether_replacement:
from tether import Asset
Asset.search_assets(query='', scope=unreal.TetherAssetSearchScope.ALL_ASSETS, class_filter='Blueprint', case_sensitive=False, whole_word=False, max_results=-1, min_characters=0, custom_package_path='')
redirects.reason: search_assets with class_filter is the tether-canonical way; works across plugin mounts where /Game-only walks miss assets.

redirects.tether_replacement:
from tether import Asset
refs = Asset.get_package_referencers(package_name=..., hard_only=True)
# OR for both deps + refs in one call:
deps, refs = Asset.get_asset_references(asset_path=...)
redirects.reason: Tether wrapper takes a package name string instead of AssetIdentifier struct — much less ceremony.

redirects.tether_replacement:
from tether import Level
actor_paths = Level.find_actors_by_class(class_path=..., max_results=-1)
redirects.reason: Tether returns actor paths (strings), avoiding the result-type confusion that hitting raw UObject lists triggers.

Tether wrapper has the same shape but is audited + token-cost-counted; raw call walks the registry without telemetry.

redirects.tether_replacement:
from tether import Asset
paths, _ = Asset.search_assets_in_all_content(query='<asset_short_name>', max_results=10)
# OR if you have the full path already, just LoadObject — find_asset_data is rarely the right call
redirects.reason: find_asset_data forces an exact path match; agents using it usually meant a name search. ALL_ASSETS scope catches plugin-mounted assets the registry-by-path approach would miss.

redirects.tether_replacement:
from tether import PoseSearch
entries = PoseSearch.list_database_animations(database_path=...)
# DatabaseAnimationAssets is private: in UE 5.7 — get_editor_property('database_animation_assets') raises.
redirects.reason: PoseSearchDatabase.DatabaseAnimationAssets is private:; only the tether library can read it. Trying get_editor_property is the most common dead-end.

redirects.tether_replacement:
from tether import Chooser
rows = Chooser.list_chooser_rows(chooser_table_path=...)
# ResultsStructs / DisabledRows / NestedChoosers / FallbackResult are private: — only the tether library can read them.
redirects.reason: ChooserTable's load-bearing arrays are private:; get_editor_property silently returns None and agents loop forever debugging it.
